support.title: Didn't find your answer?
support.description: Our dispatcher is available around the clock to help you.
support.contactHint: Find the dispatcher’s contact in your ticket or booking confirmation.

ticket.question: Do I need to print my ticket?
ticket.answer: No. Show the driver your e-ticket on your phone.

payment.question: How and when do I pay?
payment.answer: There is no prepayment. Pay in cash or by card when you board the bus.

luggage.question: How much luggage can I bring?
luggage.answer: Typically, you can bring one suitcase weighing up to 25–30 kg and hand luggage at no extra charge. Check with the carrier about oversized luggage.

border.question: What should I do if I'm delayed at the border?
border.answer: Contact the dispatcher using the details in your ticket or booking confirmation. They are available around the clock and can advise you about the next steps.
